concepts.way: misconception: assignment empties/moves the source (b becomes 0)
concepts.quote: a = 20, b = 0, because the 20 moved over to a.
concepts.why: The student thinks a = b moves the value and leaves b empty. Assignment actually copies the value, so b stays 20.

concepts.way: misconception: a variable loses its value when it is the source of an assignment
concepts.quote: b = 0, because the 20 moved over to a
concepts.why: The student thinks reading b in an assignment empties it. Only an assignment to b changes b, so b keeps 20.
